newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR decline, one-year maturity steady.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR decline, one-year maturity steady.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were generally lower on Friday, except for the one-year rate which remained unchanged, following the decline in their respective spot rates, traders said.
One trader attributed the downtrend to the softening of the overnight and termed rates in the interbank market.
The one-year PHIBOR was unchanged as banks were still divided on the direction of the longer-termed rates, as some traders have deemed it to be very low.
PHIBOR are average rates of foreign exchange forward swaps quoted by 20 banks operating in the country.
